summary: Architectural and UI/UX Plan for the standalone Microstock FTP Uploader (Phase 1: Dreamstime Proof of Concept) covering the Shadcn execution workspace, Electron safeStorage credential vault, extension-based Dreamstime routing, 60fps throttled IPC telemetry bridge, 3x exponential backoff retry queue, Dry-Run Simulator, and SQLite persistent session logging.
